##### Project general facts

Elia Hills is an exclusive residential townhouse community, designed to combine contemporary architecture with natural surroundings and a comfortable family-oriented lifestyle. The development comprises 31 four-bedroom townhouses set on a 5,930 sqm plot, with each residence offering spacious layouts, private outdoor areas, and a strong focus on privacy, comfort, and functionality.

The community provides a range of amenities designed for everyday convenience and leisure, including landscaped areas, a gymnasium, children’s play areas, private parking, and an events hall. The thoughtfully planned surroundings create opportunities for both quiet relaxation and social interaction within the residential community.

The townhouses feature private terraces or balconies, double-glazed windows, and bathrooms equipped with high-quality Jaquar sanitary fittings, vanity units, and mirrors. Selected bedrooms include private bathrooms, while underfloor heating throughout the residences provides additional comfort throughout the year.

##### Location description and benefits

Elia Hills is located in Amman, a city known for its distinctive hills, historic character, and evolving modern lifestyle. The location combines access to established residential areas with convenient connections to educational, healthcare, retail, recreational, and business destinations across the city.

The development is situated close to a number of everyday amenities and key destinations. Al Zaytoonah University is approximately a 1-minute drive away, while IKEA Amman is around 2 minutes away. The Kingdom University Hospital, Dunes Club, and Opal Hotel Amman can be reached within approximately 6 minutes, with The International School of Choueifat and Bisharat Golf Club around 7 minutes away.

The location also provides convenient access to major leisure and transport destinations, including Amman National Park, around 8 minutes away, and the 7th Circle, approximately 14 minutes by car. Queen Alia International Airport is around 15 minutes away, making Elia Hills a convenient residential choice for both everyday city living and wider connectivity.
